recommendations:
TOP RESTAURANTS
1. Sushi Saito, Japanese, 20,000-30,000 JPY (14,000-21,000 INR) per person, must-order Omakase.
2. Narisawa, Japanese, 15,000-25,000 JPY (10,500-17,500 INR) per person, must-order Satoyama.
3. L'Effervescence, French, 12,000-20,000 JPY (8,400-14,000 INR) per person, must-order Foie Gras.
4. Tofuya Ukai, Japanese, 5,000-10,000 JPY (3,500-7,000 INR) per person, must-order Tofu Katsu.
5. Ichiran Shibuya, Japanese, 1,000-2,000 JPY (700-1,400 INR) per person, must-order Tonkotsu Ramen.

TOP ATTRACTIONS
1. Tokyo Tower, panoramic views of the city, best time to go at sunset, entry fee 900 JPY (630 INR).
2. Meiji Shrine, serene Shinto shrine, best time to go early morning, entry fee free.
3. Tsukiji Outer Market, fresh sushi and seafood, best time to go at 5 am, entry fee free.
4. Asakusa Kannon Temple, historic Buddhist temple, best time to go at noon, entry fee 500 JPY (350 INR).
5. Imperial Palace, main residence of the Emperor, best time to go at 10 am, entry fee free.

HIDDEN GEMS
1. Nezu Museum, tranquil garden and art museum.
2. Kappabashi Dougu Street, unique kitchenware shops.
3. Yanaka Ginza, charming old shopping street.

TRAVEL TIPS
1. Local customs: bow upon greeting and remove shoes before entering homes.
2. Best transport: use the efficient subway system.
3. Common scams to avoid: beware of overpriced restaurants in tourist areas.
4. Useful phrases: learn basic Japanese phrases like "konnichiwa" and "arigatou".
5. Safety notes: be mindful of pickpocketing in crowded areas.

SHOPPING
1. Shibuya 109, trendy clothing, 5,000-10,000 JPY (3,500-7,000 INR).
2. Ginza Mitsukoshi, luxury goods, 10,000-50,000 JPY (7,000-35,000 INR).
3. Ameya Yokocho, traditional snacks, 500-1,000 JPY (350-700 INR).
